title: Russian ‘attempts to intimidate Europe will fail’, says EU’s Kallas as Germany blames Moscow for Leipzig drone incident – Europe live
description:
EU’s policy chief says drone incident at German airport ‘had the hallmarks of state-sponsored terrorism’

German police have opened a investigation into yesterday’s attempt to disrupt the operation of a power substation near Brandenburg.

In a statement, Brandenburg police said they were leading a probe on suspicion of attempting to disrupt public services, causing an explosion and damaging critical infrastructure as well as forming a terrorist organisation
